tei:div.tei:p: A playful, powerful, passionate reading for Passover seder or any time. Can be chanted to the traditional Ashkenazi lilt for the Four Questions. Melody here.
“Mah Nishtanah: What Needs to Change” was written by Kohenet Ilana Joy Streit in Adar Bet / March 2014.
